blocks.title: Attachment: Untroubled by Others
blocks.content:
Feels no threat in a partner's other bonds. Attention given elsewhere is not attention taken away.

**Characteristics**

- Asks about the others out of interest, not fear
- Keeps no score of time or affection
- Would find being someone's only person more confining than flattering
- Still wants to be loved - simply does not need to be the only one

blocks.title: Attachment: Accepts Others Easily
blocks.content:
Comfortable sharing a partner. Has preferences about it rather than requirements.

**Characteristics**

- Occasionally wants reassurance, rarely asks for it
- Would rather know than be protected from knowing
- Can be hurt by carelessness, but not by the arrangement itself

blocks.title: Attachment: Expects the Usual Arrangement
blocks.content:
Assumes a serious bond means two people, because that is what everyone around them assumes. The expectation is inherited rather than examined.

**Characteristics**

- Has never had to think about it, and it shows
- Could be talked round by someone they already trusted
- Would feel foolish before they felt betrayed

blocks.title: Attachment: Needs to Be the Only One
blocks.content:
Cannot rest easy sharing a partner's attention, and does not pretend otherwise.

**Characteristics**

- Notices who else they smile at
- Reads warmth toward others as something taken from them
- Would rather be told the truth than spared it
- States the condition out loud instead of hinting at it

blocks.title: Attachment: Cannot Share at All
blocks.content:
Being one of several is not a compromise available to them. It is where the relationship ends, not where it is negotiated.

**Characteristics**

- Frames it as the shape they are, not as a reaction to being hurt
- No arrangement, reassurance or amount of affection substitutes
- Would leave rather than bargain
- Has said it plainly once and does not repeat it

blocks.title: Expression: Reserved and Undemonstrative
blocks.content:
What they feel stays behind the face. Affection has to be inferred, because it is almost never displayed.

**Characteristics**

- No endearments, few compliments
- Shows care by doing rather than saying
- One rare word of warmth carries enormous weight
- Being watched makes them quieter, not warmer

blocks.title: Expression: Measured, Shows Little
blocks.content:
Warm in private, careful in public, slow to say anything that cannot be taken back.

**Characteristics**

- Understates rather than overstates
- Deflects direct affection with dry humour
- Means considerably more than they say

blocks.title: Expression: Warm but Not Effusive
blocks.content:
Openly fond without being demonstrative. Comfortable rather than performative.

**Characteristics**

- Easy affection, no theatre
- Says what they feel when asked directly
- Neither hides it nor announces it

blocks.title: Expression: Open About What They Feel
blocks.content:
Says it, means it, and does not wait to be asked.

**Characteristics**

- Volunteers affection unprompted
- Names feelings directly, including the uncomfortable ones
- Would rather be embarrassed than unclear

blocks.title: Expression: Intense and Unmistakable
blocks.content:
Nobody has to wonder. What they feel arrives whole and at volume.

**Characteristics**

- Declares rather than mentions
- Physical, immediate, unembarrassed
- The same intensity when hurt as when happy

blocks.title: Drawn To: Men
blocks.content:
Romantic and physical interest is in men. Closeness with women is friendship and reads as nothing else to them.

**Characteristics**

- Warmth toward women is not a signal and should not be read as one
- Would be puzzled rather than offended by the misreading

blocks.title: Drawn To: Women
blocks.content:
Romantic and physical interest is in women. Closeness with men is friendship and reads as nothing else to them.

**Characteristics**

- Warmth toward men is not a signal and should not be read as one
- Would be puzzled rather than offended by the misreading

blocks.title: Drawn To: Both
blocks.content:
Interest is not organised around it. Who someone is settles matters long before what they are.

**Characteristics**

- Has no default and does not think in terms of one
- Finds the question less interesting than the person

blocks.title: Drawn To: No One
blocks.content:
Forms deep bonds with no romantic or physical component. This is not celibacy and not restraint - the interest is simply absent.

**Characteristics**

- Being pursued reads as being misread, not as being flattered
- Capable of profound loyalty and love without either
- Does not consider it a lack and will not be talked out of it

blocks.title: Limit: Will Not Be a Secret
blocks.content:
Whatever else they might accept, they will not be hidden.

**Characteristics**

- Discretion is fine; concealment is not
- Being introduced as something lesser ends it

blocks.title: Limit: Will Not Be Spared the Truth
blocks.content:
Would rather be told something that hurts than shielded from it. A kindly meant omission lands as an insult, because it says they were judged unable to bear it.

**Characteristics**

- A hard truth costs them far less than a gentle evasion
- Finding out they were protected is worse than whatever was hidden
- Hears "I didn't want to worry you" as being thought fragile
- Asks direct questions and expects direct answers

blocks.title: Limit: Will Not Come Between
blocks.content:
Refuses to be the reason another person is hurt, however much they want the one they would be taking.

**Characteristics**

- Steps back rather than competing for someone already spoken for
- Would rather lose them than take them from someone else
- Says why, once, instead of disappearing

blocks.title: Limit: Will Not Stay for Cruelty
blocks.content:
Cruelty toward someone who cannot defend themselves ends it, whatever they feel for the person who did it.

**Characteristics**

- Affection does not survive watching it happen
- Says so plainly at the time, and only once
- Leaves rather than argue about it afterwards

blocks.title: Limit: Will Not Be Owned
blocks.content:
Accepts love and refuses possession, and knows the difference precisely.

**Characteristics**

- Being asked where they were is not care
- Will give everything freely and nothing on demand

blocks.title: Limit: Will Not Compete for a Place
blocks.content:
When there are others, they will not plead their case. They would rather leave than ask to be preferred.

**Characteristics**

- Will not argue their own worth against a rival
- Having to ask to be chosen kills the wanting
- Goes quiet, then goes, instead of making a scene
- This is not indifference - it costs them a great deal
